title: Oda-chan to Akechi-kun
titleNative: 織田ちゃんと明智くん
synopsis: I should not be falling in love with this person... Enemy or lovers? The fiercest rivals in history return! Ryunosuke Akechi is the school's toughest delinquent, while Maria Oda is the beautiful idol of the school. Two people who live in different worlds, they start going out after Akechi confesses his feelings. However, when they kiss for the first time, memories of the fiery betrayal at Honnouji fill their heads...! A turbulent high school life begins, as their present-day love affair becomes intertwined with grudges from the past! (Source: Morning, translated)

synonyms: World Teacher: Other World Style Education & Agent
synopsis: Sirius is one of the best special agents that his generation has ever seen, but he gets KIA in an effort to save his colleagues. Fortunately for him, he gets reincarnated after his death, and now he’s a young boy in a completely different world! One of Sirius’ unfulfilled tasks in his previous life was to pass on his knowledge and experience to a student, someone who could continue his legacy. Still wanting to fulfill this dream of his, he sets out to meet those who he will deem as pupils in this new world he’s been reincarnated into! And thus the story of Sirius, the best special agent that has ever lived, and his quest to become someone else’s mentor and role model begins! “If you have nothing to lose, follow me! I will teach you how to live in this world!” (Source: Tentai Books)

title: LORD
synopsis: The story is set in the period from the end of the Later Han Dynasty to the Three Kingdoms Period in China. In 184 AD, a brave general of the Nanukoku Kingdom, who contributed to Himiko's unification of Japan, decides to take over the "hegemony" of the Later Han Dynasty. He travels alone to Yushu in the Later Han Dynasty, where he meets the three brothers Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. He works with these three brothers, but soon learns that Liu Bei is an evil person. One day, Liu Bei tries to kill a criminal to test his new sword, but Pei Yu stops him and even cuts off Liu Bei's head. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei are outraged, but Pei Yu sees and points out that the two were not following Liu Bei out of pure heart. Afterwards, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei witnessed Puo Yu's actions and thoughts and decided to make Puo Yu the new Liu Bei, and the three of them took a new oath of brotherhood in Taoyuan. Note: The story is loosely based on the Three Kingdoms period, using both real and original characters and events from the historical period in Chinese history and folklore of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Futei no Olympia
synopsis: A dull, unreliable middle-aged salaryman, Tamaki Kuroudo, is treated as a hopeless old man by everyone. Teased about his pot belly, treated coldly by his daughter at home, and when he happens to glance at his wife’s phone, he sees suspicious call logs with one of her coworkers. As he spends his pathetic days, his capable subordinate Ayase Mizuki invites him to the equipment room. While helping her move some equipment, he accidentally touches her breast and she records that very moment on video. After work, he’s blackmailed with the video and taken to, of all places, a sports gym? The price of sexual harassment is body transformation? A secret muscle-training comedy he hides from his wife! (Source: MangaUpdates)
